title: Symplectic Tiling Billiards on Complete Affine Tori
summary: In 2023, Richard Schwartz introduced a new dynamical system which is a marriage of two types of familiar billiards, tiling billiards and symplectic billiards. In this paper we investigate this dynamical system played on tilings of the plane which arise from non-Euclidean geometries on the torus. We review the affine analogue of the flat conformal structures on the torus through the work of Oliver Baues and William Goldman, and define an open subset of this deformation space corresponding to markings of complete affine tilings of the plane.
